summary.text: Anita Somani is a Democratic physician and state representative who has represented Ohio House District 8 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is the ranking member of the House Health Committee, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Somani earned a bachelor's degree from Miami University in 1982 and an M.D. from the Medical College of Ohio in 1988, and her career experience is as a physician.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an OB/GYN who had lived and worked in the district for 30 years.
Somani defeated Republican Aaron Neumann in the November 5, 2024 general election.
She serves on the Medicaid and Health committees, and is ranking member of Health.
Kelly Hunter-Kalagidis is the Republican candidate in the 2026 general election.
